raw.query: WITH target_runs(run_id, scope_order) AS (VALUES ('rerun_verify:react_p90_W120_aggregate_L30', 1), ('rerun_verify:react_p90_W120_burst1_L30', 2), ('rerun_verify:react_p90_W120_burst3_L30', 3)), cost AS (SELECT c.run_id, c.window_name, c.policy, c.quantile, c.lead_s, c.numerator_worker_seconds, c.denominator_kind, c.denominator_run, c.denominator_worker_seconds, c.denominator_workers, c.denominator_basis, c.cost_ratio, c.denominator_window_mismatch, c.is_current FROM provenance.v_cost_ratio c JOIN target_runs t USING (run_id) WHERE c.denominator_kind = 'deployable_static_c8' AND c.is_current = true), latency AS (SELECT s.run_id, s.window_name, s.encoder_delay_p99_ms, s.queue_divergent, s.provisioned_worker_seconds FROM provenance.current_encoder_summary s JOIN target_runs t USING (run_id)), dims AS (SELECT d.run_id, d.is_current, d.superseded_by FROM provenance.v_dim d JOIN target_runs t USING (run_id) WHERE d.is_current = true), bound AS (SELECT bound_ms FROM provenance.v_sla_bound WHERE sla_metric = 'encoder_delay' AND bound_stat = 'p99') SELECT t.scope_order, c.run_id, c.window_name, c.policy, c.quantile, c.lead_s, c.numerator_worker_seconds, c.denominator_kind, c.denominator_run, c.denominator_worker_seconds, c.denominator_workers, c.cost_ratio, c.denominator_window_mismatch, c.is_current AS cost_is_current, d.is_current AS dim_is_current, d.superseded_by, l.encoder_delay_p99_ms, b.bound_ms AS sla_bound_ms, (l.encoder_delay_p99_ms <= b.bound_ms AND NOT l.queue_divergent) AS meets_sla, l.queue_divergent, c.denominator_basis FROM target_runs t JOIN cost c USING (run_id) JOIN latency l USING (run_id) JOIN dims d USING (run_id) CROSS JOIN bound b ORDER BY t.scope_order
